prompt: A volunteer offers to rehang the board and erase the answer to question 8 before certificates are printed. Which response follows both documents?
promptZh: 證書印製前，有志工提議架回看板並擦除第 8 題答案。哪個回應符合兩份文件？

options.text: Rehang the board and revise the signed sheet before changing the register.
options.zh: 重架看板並先改簽名的答題紙，再改登記簿。
options.whyZh: 不得更改原答，也不可只為更正重新架板。

options.text: Leave everything unchanged because the last round has finished.
options.zh: 最後一回合已結束，所以所有紀錄都不改。
options.whyZh: 最後一回合後仍可更正漏計，應更新登記簿。

options.text: Leave the board down and preserve the original answer; correct the register.
options.zh: 不重架看板，保留原答；更正登記簿。
options.whyZh: 看板已撤，原答不能替換，但仍應在登記簿補計一分。

options.text: Update only the certificate and leave the register as it is.
options.zh: 只更改證書，登記簿保持原樣。
options.whyZh: 應先改登記簿，證書採正式登記數字。

explanationZh: 看板已撤，原答不能替換，但仍應在登記簿補計一分。
evidence: it cannot replace a submitted answer. / update the register first. / do not put it back up just for a late correction. / The hall board came down when the audience left.

vocabulary.note: preliminary 表示尚非正式的結果。

difficultyRationale: 整合三種載體不同的更正權限。
